_tolerance: The editor and the design layout are equal to the pixel (sizes are checked). Text is rasterised by two engines, so text-dense regions differ at glyph edges whatever the weight (tried 400 and 450). `fraction` is the measured worst case over the modes plus one point; regions with none use the 1% decision.
